$comment: Root-level config for `firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore` from .github/workflows/deploy.yml (SERVER_PLAN.md §9.1/§9.2). Local dev does NOT use this file: relay/firebase.json drives the Firestore/Auth emulators baked into relay/emulator.Dockerfile, and web/firebase.json is for a local Hosting preview of web/out. This file exists only so the two deploy targets (Hosting from web/, Firestore rules/indexes from relay/) can be deployed together with one `firebase deploy` invocation from the repo root, without either local-dev config having to know about the other.
